culprit_citations.quoted_text: Accurate Finance Sub, LLC | fair value 550 | percentage of net assets 0.1

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted position total of $877.069m agrees with the filing schedule total of $877.060m within $0.009m, while the filing reports net assets of $503.474m. The source schedule prints percentage of net assets to only one decimal place: for example, $0.550m / $503.474m is about 0.109%, disclosed as 0.1%. The schedule total similarly gives 174.3% for $877.060m. Thus a tight exact identity will predictably flag correctly disclosed rounded percentages; the 29.39% violation rate does not establish bad extracted values.
